# Eclipse Systems

Eclipse Systems is a custom software solutions company at https://eclipsesystems.pro. The company consults with businesses to understand their workflows, then designs and builds working software around those needs.

Eclipse Systems is not positioned as one timekeeping or invoicing product. Timekeeping, invoicing, shift operations, training portals, storefronts, dashboards, authentication, roles, permissions, reporting, and integrations are examples of systems and modules Eclipse can build with.

The offer is a spectrum:
- Buy a proven package as-is when an existing Eclipse system already fits the workflow.
- Customize a proven package when a client wants a faster starting point with business-specific screens, rules, roles, and integrations.
- Commission a bespoke build when the client needs software designed around a specific workflow.

Existing Eclipse work can be used in two ways. It can serve as a demo or proof of quality for prospective custom software clients. It can also be packaged as a ready-to-buy solution for customers who want a proven system off the shelf.

Common software Eclipse Systems can build:
- Internal intranets, employee portals, and admin workspaces
- Timekeeping, approvals, invoicing, and billing systems
- Training, onboarding, certification, and policy acknowledgement portals
- Storefronts, product catalogs, checkout flows, and customer accounts
- Dashboards, reporting tools, and operational command centers
- Integrations between existing business tools

Pricing is scoped after discovery. Eclipse Systems does not publish a generic seat-price grid for custom work because price depends on reuse of existing modules, workflow complexity, roles and permissions, integrations, data migration, reporting needs, launch support, and maintenance requirements.
